title: Code calling gpt-3.5-turbo, gpt-4, gpt-4-turbo, o1, o3-mini or o4-mini breaks on 2026-10-23
symptoms: Model ids that coding assistants still suggest by default stop being served
Requests fail for a model name that worked the week before
cause: OpenAI retires the legacy GPT snapshots, including gpt-3.5-turbo, gpt-4, gpt-4-turbo, gpt-4o-2024-05-13, o1, o1-pro, o3-mini and o4-mini, on 2026-10-23. Older code and model defaults hardcode these names.
fix: Replace each model with its listed substitute: gpt-3.5-turbo and o4-mini move to gpt-5.6-terra; gpt-4, gpt-4-turbo, gpt-4o-2024-05-13, o1 and o3-mini move to gpt-5.6-sol; o1-pro moves to gpt-5.6-sol with reasoning.mode pro; gpt-4.1-nano moves to gpt-5.6-luna. Keep the model id in configuration so the next retirement is a one line change.
affected: OpenAI API legacy snapshots, shutdown 2026-10-23; gpt-4o and gpt-4.1 snapshots follow on 2027-01-14
